comment: The Root CV input is scaled wrongly in the source: src/MentalQuantiser.cpp:108 rounds the voltage and divides it by 12, and line 109 then multiplies that by a twelfth again, so a volt moves the root by a 144th of a volt, about a twelfth of a semitone, rather than by the semitone or the octave a jack marked Root would suggest. The line for that jack says what it does and names the conflict with the panel. The Root knob is configured -6.5 to 6.5 and rounded (src/MentalQuantiser.cpp:52), so the outermost semitone is reached only at the exact end of the travel. The quantiser has no trigger input and no sample and hold: it rounds every sample. The panel prints Quantiser, In, Out, Root and cv.
